roadmap.name: Story: Chapters 1-2
roadmap.goal: Play the story, protect the one missable meditation, start scanning and studying everything you meet.

roadmap.name: Story: Chapters 3-4 + partners
roadmap.goal: Both characters roam together now: partner trophies, robbery tools, character strands and garages open up.

roadmap.name: Story: Chapter 5 + finale
roadmap.goal: Finish the story. Keep a clean save before the final mission; free roam continues after the credits.

roadmap.name: 100% checklist grind
roadmap.goal: The long haul: the 100% checklist unlocks after the story. Most grind trophies pop here.

roadmap.name: Strangers, cleanup, Platinum
roadmap.goal: Stranger strands, character finales and anything left, then the Platinum lands.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. No multiplayer, no DLC and no difficulty setting stand in the way; the whole hunt is single-player and fits in one playthrough, with the 100% checklist behind A Long Road taking most of the roughly 200 hours.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically the instant the last of them pops.
Follow the five roadmap stages in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then strangers and cleanup.
Budget about 200 hours in total, with 60-80 on the story, about 100 on the checklist and 10-20 on cleanup.
Keep cheats off the whole run: turning one on disables trophies and saving.
facts: There is no online trophy and no DLC trophy; every one of the 55 is earned in single-player.
One playthrough is enough, and there is no difficulty setting and no New Game+ mode.
On Xbox the same goal exists as the Mythic achievement, worth 0 Gamerscore, since the other 54 add up to the full 1,000.
The set is rated 4 out of 10 for difficulty, so the challenge is time and thoroughness rather than skill.
Free roam continues after the story ends, so nothing except the Chapter 1 meditation needs doing before the credits.
Exophase lists this as the rarest trophy on the set, with 0.00% of tracked players holding it at launch.

dispute.q: How long does the Platinum take?
dispute.a: About 200 hours: 60-80 story, ~100 checklist, ~10-20 cleanup.
dispute.b: 250+ hours, up to 300 or more, because the 100% checklist is far bigger than it first looks.
dispute.call: Plan for 200 hours and treat Push Square's 250-300 as the slow-case buffer; the roadmap stages here add up to 200.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Play through Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1, and it pops when the mission ends. Nothing about how you play the mission matters.
steps: Start a new game and play through the opening until the mission Gone Fishing begins.
Follow the mission objectives to the end; the trophy pops as the mission completes.
Do not worry about style or speed: no story trophy depends on how a mission is played.
facts: This is the first mission of Chapter 1 and the first trophy most players earn.
It cannot be missed: it is tied to required story progress.
Exophase shows it as the most common trophy on the list, held by 100.00% of tracked players.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It often pops a little late, once you have started the first mission of Chapter 2, so do not panic if it does not appear on the chapter's final cutscene.
steps: Play through every main mission of Chapter 1 in order.
Start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, if the trophy has not popped yet.
Before leaving Chapter 1, finish the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude and make a manual save.
facts: Chapter trophies regularly pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.
Chapter 1 holds the most missable content in the game, almost all of it outside trophies.
The game gives 15 manual save slots plus one autosave; a save at the end of each chapter is the recommended habit.
The first three chapter trophies all pop late, once the next chapter has begun.
Saving at the end of Chapter 1 protects both the meditation and the house contents.

dispute.q: When does the Chapter 1 trophy pop?
dispute.a: At the end of Chapter 1, on the final cutscene, as the description suggests.
dispute.b: After the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, once the next chapter has begun.
dispute.call: Expect the late pop. Start Chapter 2 before worrying that anything went wrong.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it can pop late, once Chapter 3 has begun with Welcome to Vice City.
steps: Play through every main mission of Chapter 2, including Breakfast Run and Coffee Break.
Begin Chapter 3 with Welcome to Vice City if the trophy has not popped at the chapter break.
Use the new two-character roaming after Coffee Break to start the partner trophies.
facts: The asterisks in the name are how PlayStation itself publishes it.
Chapter 2 is where switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, which several later trophies need.
No story trophy can be missed, and none depends on mission performance.

dispute.q: When exactly does two-character roaming unlock?
dispute.a: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch and call your partner in.
dispute.b: Right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, earlier than Coffee Break.
dispute.call: Coffee Break is the safer marker: PowerPyx and GTABase both tie the partner trophies to it, and OutputLog's earlier claim is a lone reading.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, which catches players off guard.
steps: Play through every main mission of Chapter 3, including The Cartel Heist.
Play the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, to trigger the pop.
During Chapter 3, start Race Against Yago the moment it appears; it carries an hourglass timer.
facts: This is the latest-popping chapter trophy: it waits until two missions into Chapter 4.
Chapter 3 opens the robbery tools: the Dye Pack Jammer, the Snap Gun and Yasmani as a fence.
Several character strands start in Chapter 3, including Andy's (Lucia only) and Tyrone's (Jason only).
PowerPyx and GTABase both place the pop after the first two Chapter 4 missions.
Chapter 3 also opens the Dye Pack Jammer and the Snap Gun, the robbery tools for later trophies.

dispute.q: When does the Chapter 3 trophy pop?
dispute.a: At the end of Chapter 3, on the final cutscene, as the description suggests.
dispute.b: After the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
dispute.call: Play two missions into Chapter 4 before worrying. This is the latest-popping chapter trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It pops after the final mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero.
steps: Play through every main mission of Chapter 4, including Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown.
Finish the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero, to trigger the pop.
Before the finale stretch, do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock bank vaults.
facts: Chapter 4 holds three named-mission trophies, more than any other chapter.
The bank vault robberies that Maximum Withdrawal needs only open near the end of this chapter.
No story trophy can be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy: finish the final mission of the game. Free roam continues afterwards, so the whole cleanup phase can wait until after the credits.
steps: Play through Chapter 5 to the final mission, Starting From Zero.
Keep a manual save from just before the final mission, untouched by cheats.
After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist.
facts: This is one of only two gold trophies; the other is A Long Road for 100% completion.
It is worth 50 Gamerscore on Xbox, the second-biggest single award after A Long Road's 100.
There is no mission replay, so the pre-finale save is the only way back to the late story.
No trophy depends on how the final mission is played.

dispute.q: What does the official description actually say?
dispute.a: Complete the final mission, as PlayStation publishes it and Exophase lists it.
dispute.b: Complete Chapter 5, as Insider Gaming, Beebom and CULTR word it.
dispute.call: The official text wins: Exophase and the PSN list say final mission, and the chapter wording is other sites paraphrasing.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission. It pops during the mission itself.
steps: Reach Chapter 2 and play the story until the mission Breakfast Run appears.
Complete Breakfast Run; the trophy pops during the mission.
Keep playing to Coffee Break, which opens two-character roaming.
facts: Breakfast Run is the first named-mission trophy of the story.
It cannot be missed and needs no special approach.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. It pops during the mission.
steps: Reach Chapter 3 and play the story until The Cartel Heist appears.
Complete The Cartel Heist; the trophy pops during the mission.
facts: The Cartel Heist is the Chapter 3 named-mission trophy.
It cannot be missed and needs no special approach.
At 25 Gamerscore it is one of the higher-value bronze trophies on Xbox.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission. It pops during the mission.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and play the story until the mission Child's Play appears.
Complete Child's Play; the trophy pops during the mission.
facts: Child's Play is one of three named-mission trophies in Chapter 4.
It cannot be missed and needs no special approach.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission. It pops during the mission.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and play the story until the mission Headliners appears.
Complete Headliners; the trophy pops during the mission.
facts: Headliners is one of three named-mission trophies in Chapter 4.
It cannot be missed and needs no special approach.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission set at Vice City International Airport. It pops during the mission.
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and play the story until the mission VCIA Takedown appears.
Complete VCIA Takedown; the trophy pops during the mission.
facts: VCIA Takedown is the third named-mission trophy of Chapter 4.
It cannot be missed and needs no special approach.
The airport returns later as the setting for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission. It pops during the mission.
steps: Reach Chapter 5 and play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Complete Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops during the mission.
facts: Operation Savage Glory is the only named-mission trophy in Chapter 5.
It cannot be missed and needs no special approach.
The story runs five chapters in total and takes about 60 to 80 hours.

dispute.q: How many chapters does the story have?
dispute.a: Five chapters, with the final mission in Chapter 5.
dispute.b: Four chapters plus a finale, since the chapter trophies only cover Chapters 1 to 4.
dispute.call: Five is the better reading: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and TechForNerd all describe a five-chapter story, and Snow Storm sits in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the longest job in the game: finish the 100% checklist. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but everything you did during the story already counts. The targets are forgiving, closer to 60% of everything the game holds, and nothing on the list is missable.
steps: Finish the story first, then open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion to see the checklist.
Work through the robbery lines: all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 8 bank vaults.
Clear the activity lines: 42 shooting range golds, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges.
Finish the collection lines: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 15 of 18 meditations.
Scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals with the binoculars.
Complete 100 optional tasks; there are 200 to 300 in the game, so this comes naturally.
Finish all 15 of Bret's Target Decks and 5 of Kenton's 7 treasure sets.
facts: The checklist has about 35 lines, and only a few demand everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
Most lines only need a share: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts.
Nothing on the checklist is missable; every line can still be finished in free roam after the story.
PowerPyx puts the checklist at roughly 60% of true completion, with most side quests not required at all.
The checklist stage takes about 100 hours, roughly half the whole Platinum run.
At 100 Gamerscore this is the single biggest award on the Xbox list.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, which funds the garages, the $100,000 of shopping and the laundering.
Kenton's 7 shipwrecks feed both the treasure sets line and the 33 underwater discoveries line.
Exophase lists this at 0.00% of tracked players, the joint-rarest gold on the set.

dispute.q: How demanding is 100% really?
dispute.a: Lenient: closer to 60% true completion, with most side quests and many collectibles not required.
dispute.b: Near-total: you do not need everything, but you do need almost everything, including 15 of 18 card sets.
dispute.call: Both are describing the same list from different angles. The targets are partial, but the partial targets are still huge, so budget the full 100 hours.

miss.w: Opens after the story; a few magazine copies sit in Chapter 1 buildings that close off.
miss.p: Grab the magazines in Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends. The checklist only needs 30 of 34, and copies spawn elsewhere, so a few misses never block it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida, mixing the four kinds however you like. Flying under bridges is the quickest kind to farm, and the optional challenge attached to each stunt is not needed. Keep going past 250, because the 100% checklist wants 300.
steps: Open Map, Exploration, Stunt Spots to see every stunt you have found, each with its own name.
Fly under bridges first: with 202 of them they are the fastest route to 250.
Add stunt jumps (130), knife flights (40) and base jumps (25) to taste; the four kinds mix freely.
Skip the optional challenges on stunt map icons; performing the stunt once counts as completed.
Keep going to 300 stunts, since the 100% checklist asks for 300.
facts: There are 397 stunts in total: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Progress by region lives under Progress, Activities, Stunts; press R3 on a category to see it broken down.
Stunts stay marked on the map once completed, so you can compare against a location guide.
The trophy's own tracker in the trophy list shows your total as you go.
At 40 Gamerscore this is one of the higher-value silver trophies on Xbox.
Exophase lists this at 0.00% of tracked players at launch.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest kind to farm, with 202 of them on the map.
Stunt jumps number 130, knife flights 40 and base jumps 25, so bridges are the biggest pool.

dispute.q: 250 stunts or 300?
dispute.a: 250 for the trophy, in any mix of the four kinds.
dispute.b: 300 for the 100% checklist, which asks for more than the trophy.
dispute.call: Aim for 300 from the start. The trophy pops on the way, and the extra 50 are needed anyway.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types at least once. Most come naturally from the story and the other trophies, so this is close to a free trophy if you play broadly.
steps: Open Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see the nine types and how many of each you have done.
Fish, hunt, play golf, try a shooting range and play pool.
Score a basketball hoop, finish an arcade game, win any race and perform any stunt.
Filter the map for Activities, the blue dumbbell icon, to find anything still missing.
facts: The nine types are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
A race win can be a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race.
Most players earn this without trying, while working on the other trophies.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The challenges have three difficulty tiers each, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. Range sessions also raise your Focus, which helps Gunslinger.
steps: Find the ranges on the map under Activities, Shooting Ranges.
Work through all 42 challenges, earning gold in each; most have three difficulty tiers.
Check locked challenges on the map to see what condition opens them.
Track progress under Progress, Activities, Shooting Ranges.
facts: There are 42 gold medals to earn across the shooting ranges.
The 100% checklist also needs all 42, so this is not skippable on the Platinum road.
Shooting ranges raise Focus, which lengthens Combat Focus for Gunslinger.
GamesFuze names this one of the two hardest trophies, next to A Long Road.
Exophase lists this at 0.03% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: How many shooting ranges are there?
dispute.a: 12 ranges holding the 42 challenges between them.
dispute.b: Two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero.
dispute.call: The 42 challenges are agreed everywhere; the range count differs because Push Square counts buildings and PowerPyx counts range sites. Follow the 42, not the building count.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location while you are there. Some locations charge an entry fee.
steps: Find the locations on the map under Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones.
Win one drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Stay and finish the remaining races at each location: the 100% checklist wants all 42.
Bring cash: some locations require an entry fee.
facts: There are 14 Top Fun locations and 42 drone races in total, three per location.
The 100% checklist needs all 42 drone time trials completed.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Winning the same race again does not count, and there are 40 to choose from. The 100% checklist wants 30 unique race wins, so keep going past 20.
steps: Track every race location under Progress, Activities, Racing.
Win 20 different races; repeats of a race you already won do not count.
Keep going to 30 unique wins for the 100% checklist.
Most race locations let you hire a car; watch your car's Rating if you bring your own.
facts: There are 40 unique race locations to choose from.
The 100% checklist also wants 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.
Race challenge gold medals number 13, of which the 100% checklist needs 10.
Winning the same race again never counts toward either target.

dispute.q: 20 races or 30?
dispute.a: 20 different race wins for the trophy.
dispute.b: 30 unique race wins for the 100% checklist.
dispute.call: Aim for 30 unique wins. The trophy pops at 20 and the checklist line finishes at 30.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge; one of his requests is a parrotfish over 2 kg.
steps: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Wait for Cal's text, which marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento.
Take a boat with a fishing rod to the marked spot; boats in the area can be borrowed.
Fish the marked area until you land what Cal asked for, including a parrotfish over 2 kg.
Beat Cal in his fishing challenge to pop the trophy.
facts: Cal's quests stay available later, so this is not missable.
Fishing also raises Focus, which helps Gunslinger.
Exophase lists this at 16.73% of tracked players, one of the most common non-story trophies.

miss.w: Opens after Feng Shui in Chapter 1; the quest line is easy to leave behind.
miss.p: Start Cal's quests as soon as his text arrives. They stay open later, but doing them early keeps the fishing gear familiar for the Focus grind.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game. Three run on the TV at home and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it.
steps: Pick any of the four games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck.
Play the first three on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, from Chapter 1 on.
Find Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world instead, if you prefer it.
Finish every level of your chosen game at least once; the extra challenges are not needed.
facts: The home TV games are briefly unavailable during some story sections but come back, and stay open after the story.
The 100% checklist wants all four video games played, so try each one eventually.
Exophase lists this at 1.84% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: Do the home TV games disappear?
dispute.a: They go out of reach for most of Chapter 2 and come back in Chapter 3.
dispute.b: They are only briefly unavailable during some story sections and stay open after the story.
dispute.call: Either way the trophy is safe: one finished game is all it needs, and the arcade cabinets never go away. Do it in Chapter 1 and forget it.

miss.w: Home TV games are reported out of reach during parts of Chapter 2.
miss.p: Finish one game in Chapter 1 while the TV is right there. The arcade cabinets are a permanent fallback.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and then texts her an address in Belville. Complete all five of Andy's quests in order; the last one, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and wait for Andy's call, then the text with the Belville address.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain, parts 1 to 3.
Complete Pay the Cellerica Fee, then Peach! and Read the Label.
Finish Puff Puff Pass, meeting at the warehouse, to pop the trophy.
facts: Andy only talks to Lucia, so switch to her if the contact will not engage.
The strand is marked automatically once it starts.
All five quests stay available after the story.
Exophase lists this at 0.02% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from seven shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers, dig with the metal detector and bring each haul back to his shop in Key Lento. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again in Chapter 2 or 3, so the strand is not missable.
steps: After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, wait for Kenton's call, then find his green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive at the purple treasure chest markers and use the metal detector to dig up each wreck's treasure.
Turn in the first set, then return when he calls again; he marks more wrecks each time.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks and finish his final mission, Maritime Disputes.
If he goes quiet after Chapter 1, keep playing; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 can speed his return.
facts: Track progress under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees and Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.
The 100% checklist needs 5 of 7 treasure sets, but the 33 underwater discoveries need all of them.
Kenton's diving pauses after Chapter 1 and returns later; it is not treated as missable.
Exophase lists this at 0.06% of tracked players at launch.

miss.w: Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and his diving pauses until Chapter 2-3.
miss.p: Start his wrecks in Chapter 1, then do not panic when he vanishes; he texts Jason again later. A save before the end of Chapter 1 costs nothing.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand opens at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Complete his five jobs in order; the last one, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Thrillbillies, checking out the mud club.
Complete Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab and Mall Rats, joining Billy on jobs.
Steal the Impaler, then finish Hometown Heroes to pop the trophy.
facts: Billy's strand is marked automatically once Coffee Break is done.
All five jobs stay available after the story.
Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, since it has its own trophy.
Exophase lists this at 0.02% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands. Only certain questlines count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed, while the questlines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand, and do Yago's timed race the moment it appears.
steps: Find stranger strands in the open world; they are not part of the 100% checklist.
Finish Kirk's strand: the Skunk Ape search, the tree effigies and Mr. Mangrove.
Finish Kyle's strand at McKittrick Farm, including the chemical collection.
Finish Yago's racing strand, and start Race Against Yago the moment it appears.
Finish Pilot Pete's delivery strand, including the Last Mile jobs.
Keep going until the trophy's own progress counter reads 8 of 8.
facts: PowerPyx counts 14 stranger strands in the game, but only some qualify for this trophy.
The remaining qualifying strands beyond the four confirmed ones are still being confirmed by the guides.
Strangers & Freaks is not part of 100%, so it can still be open after A Long Road pops.
All stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story, apart from the Yago timing question.
Exophase lists this at 0.00% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: Can Race Against Yago expire and cost you the trophy?
dispute.a: Yes, it may: it carries an hourglass icon, and one checklist warns it can lock Yago's strand.
dispute.b: No: the bigger guides say Strangers & Freaks content stays open after the story.
dispute.call: Do the race the moment it appears, with a save first. That costs nothing and removes the only real risk on this trophy.

miss.w: Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 carries an hourglass timer and may expire.
miss.p: Save, then start the race the moment it shows up. Yago's strand counts toward this silver, and the other strands do not have timers.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wish list opens in Chapter 3, after the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal a Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City. Deliver them all to pop the trophy.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs and deliver the Zorrusso during it.
Open Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List to see the 16 cars he wants.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check whether each is on the list.
Steal each car, using the Key Cloner on locked high-end models, and drive it to his green RK icon.
Deliver cars in good condition for more money; he marks new locations as you clear his marks.
facts: The wish list includes the Pegassi Infernus, the Grotti Itali RSX and the Bravado Banshee, among 16 cars.
Cars he wants turn up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around.
His deliveries also count toward the 100 optional tasks and the $200,000 of fenced vehicles.
The strand stays available after the story.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show synthetic labs around Vice City; destroy enough of them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone hands you Spin On This, which pops the trophy.
steps: Play as Jason and finish the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Follow the purple markers to the synthetic labs in Vice City.
Destroy labs as part of Take Out Kitty Litter until Tyrone calls.
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This, shutting down the labs.
facts: Tyrone only works with Jason; Lucia cannot take these quests.
Each lab you clear also counts toward the 100 optional tasks.
Everything stays available after the story.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate 18 times across 10 spots: the Chapter 1 balcony session at Jason's house, eight free-roam spots done once each with Jason and once each with Lucia, and the final Ascent session at the top of Mount Kalaga, which only appears once the rest are done. Do the balcony session before Chapter 1 ends.
steps: After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning.
Follow her to the balcony, look at her with L2 and choose Accept when the optional quest pops.
Check Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations to confirm the counter rose by one.
After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, visit the eight free-roam spots with each character.
Work the route: Smooth Sand, then the Kelly County trio, then the Lummox County trio, then Seaside.
Watch for the popup announcing the final Ascent spot, then meditate in the stone circle at the summit.
facts: The eight free-roam spots are Smooth Sand, Swamp, Worn Stone, Red Rocks, Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff, Waterfall and Seaside.
Each free-roam spot counts twice, once per character, which is how 10 spots add up to 18 meditations.
Spots show as purple icons on the map when you get close; filter Map, Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida.
Every session raises Focus, the purple eye stat, which lengthens Combat Focus.
The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so the trophy is the stricter goal.
The final Ascent meditation stays hidden until every other session is done.
The balcony session is not marked as a spot on the map, unlike the other nine.
PowerPyx had done the Chapter 1 meditation when the trophy unlocked for them.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.
A manual save right after Down to Earth is the safety net if you miss the morning scene.

dispute.q: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation actually required?
dispute.a: Yes, treat it as required: it raises the counter, and PowerPyx had done it when the trophy popped.
dispute.b: Maybe not: it is not marked as a spot, and the final meditation may count double so the total still reaches 18.
dispute.call: Do it. It takes two minutes, it is gone after Chapter 1, and nobody has proven it is safe to skip.

miss.w: Opens the morning after Down to Earth in Chapter 1; closes permanently at the end of Chapter 1.
miss.p: Save right after Down to Earth. The next morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and Accept. Check the counter rose, then save again.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting strand is Jason-only and opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Work through his hunting quests and his 15 Target Decks; the trophy pops as you hunt the animals he requests. Which exact animal triggers it is still unconfirmed, so clearing all 15 decks is the safe route.
steps: Play as Jason after Coffee Break and wait for Bret's text marking Veteran Hunted.
Meet Bret and take his unique hunting rifle, the Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker.
Follow the purple hunting icons Bret marks on the map and bring each requested animal back to him.
Work through all 15 Target Decks, tracked under Map, Activities, Target Deck.
Use clean single shots where you can: a pristine carcass pays more, though it is not required.
facts: Bret's strand is exclusive to Jason; Lucia cannot receive his message.
The 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks, so this trophy comes naturally on the Platinum road.
Studying animals with binoculars is separate from hunting them; the checklist needs 100 studied.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: Which animal unlocks Fair Game?
dispute.a: A specific unique animal Bret requests, which the guides have not pinned down yet.
dispute.b: No single animal: clearing all 15 Target Decks covers it, whatever the trigger is.
dispute.call: Clear all 15 decks. They are required for 100% anyway, so the trigger question answers itself.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three of the 18 collectible card sets. There are 480 unique cards in total, with 18 to 36 cards per set and duplicates in multiple places. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting past three.
steps: Pick up cards as you explore; track sets under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.
Complete any three full sets to pop the trophy.
Keep going to 15 sets, which the 100% checklist requires.
Sell spare cards at pawn shops; sold cards still count toward your progress.
facts: There are 18 card sets holding 480 unique cards, with some cards found in more than one place.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road.
Exophase lists this at 0.00% of tracked players at launch.
Push Square and KeenGamer both put the 100% target at 15 of the 18 sets.
The trophy needs any three sets, so the easiest sets can be finished first.

dispute.q: 3 card sets or 15?
dispute.a: 3 complete sets for the trophy.
dispute.b: 15 of the 18 sets for the 100% checklist.
dispute.call: Keep collecting past three. The trophy pops early in the card hunt and the checklist wants 15.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app: hold Up, then hold R1 while looking at a landmark, curiosity or sculpture. There are more than 100 scannable spots, so any 100 count. Scan on foot, since the prompt appears when a scannable spot is nearby and you are walking.
steps: Hold Up to open the WAiNK app, then hold R1 while looking at a scannable object.
Scan landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23) as you travel.
Walk on foot near scannable spots: the nearby prompt only appears off a vehicle.
Track progress under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
facts: The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK locations, so the trophy and the checklist line finish together.
The same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good, so scan traffic as you drive.
No Flusher Tags are a fourth WAiNK category, with no fixed count published.
Exophase lists this at 0.00% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: How many WAiNK spots exist in total?
dispute.a: At least 89 named ones: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus tags.
dispute.b: More than 100, with no firm total published yet.
dispute.call: The total does not matter: the trophy needs any 100, and the named categories plus tags comfortably clear that.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Most fill in on their own while you chase the other trophies, and the 100% checklist wants 70, so leave the hardest 10 undone and pick the easiest ones left at the end.
steps: Open Progress, Challenges to see all 80 and their requirements.
Play normally: a large share complete by themselves during the other trophies.
Near the end, pick the easiest and quickest unfinished challenges to reach 50.
Keep going to 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist.
facts: There are 80 challenges, and the trophy needs 50 while 100% needs 70.
The Completed checkmark sits in the bottom right when you scroll over a challenge.
Leaving this trophy for late in the run is the efficient play.
Exophase lists this at 0.00% of tracked players at launch.
There are 80 challenges in total, leaving 10 unneeded even for 100%.
Many challenges complete on their own while working on other trophies.

dispute.q: 50 challenges or 70?
dispute.a: 50 for the trophy, any 50 of the 80.
dispute.b: 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist.
dispute.call: Aim for 70 and skip the 10 hardest. The trophy pops at 50 on the way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. The earliest chance is after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The easy route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. Bank vault robberies in Chapter 4 hand you 4 stars automatically, so this often pops on its own.
steps: Wait until after Coffee Break, then call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Cause enough chaos to reach a 4-star wanted level.
Ride a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia to break the search.
Keep going until you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
If it has not popped by Chapter 4, rob a bank vault with your partner: the escape counts.
facts: The trophy only pops once you are out of the red heat radius.
Shooting at a pursuing helicopter until it leaves helps the escape.
Every bank vault robbery triggers 4 stars, so the 8 vaults give 8 chances.
Exophase lists this at 0.65% of tracked players, the most common robbery trophy.

miss.w: Needs your partner, which only opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
miss.p: Do not attempt it before Coffee Break. After that, keep your partner called in whenever you cause chaos, and let the Chapter 4 vaults do it for you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, rob three shops in a row while the flashing wanted level stays up the whole time. If the stars fade to heat only, the chain breaks. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together and make a good run. The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after the third shop, so wait before hitting a fourth.
steps: Wait until after Coffee Break, then call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Gear up first: an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing.
Rob three green-icon robbery targets in a row, keeping the flashing wanted level throughout.
Take a few items in each shop and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs so each robbery counts.
Wait about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if nothing pops, hit a fourth.
facts: The three jewelry stores in north Vice City open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
Leaving the first store before police arrive can break the chain and force a fourth shop.
The wanted level must stay flashing; dropping to heat alone breaks the run.
Exophase lists this at 0.09% of tracked players at launch.
The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.
North Vice City's three jewelry stores sit close together, making a tidy run.

dispute.q: Three shops or four?
dispute.a: Three shops back-to-back, as the description says.
dispute.b: Sometimes a fourth is needed, if the first shop was hit before police arrived.
dispute.call: Hit three, wait for the delayed pop, and rob a fourth if nothing comes. The chain survives the extra shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so stand by a busy road and scan the traffic; you never need to drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops on the way.
steps: Hold Up to open the WAiNK app, then hold R1 while looking at a vehicle to scan it.
Stand by a busy road and scan everything that passes; new models add to the database.
Scan boats and aircraft too when you see them.
Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles, scrolling over each category.
facts: GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch across cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes.
Getting inside a vehicle also counts as discovering it, but scanning is faster.
The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned.
Exophase lists this at 3.25% of tracked players, the most common collectible trophy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim triggered with L3 and R3 while aiming. Buff Focus first with food, drink, a wash or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and pick a group of gang enemies at an illegal operation with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It gets easier as Focus levels up, and many players earn it naturally.
steps: Raise Focus first: eat, drink, wash or shower, then take Adrenaline to extend the effect.
Wear body armor from an Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover.
Find a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation.
Aim, press L3 and R3 to trigger Combat Focus, and drop five enemies without missing.
Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556: full-auto and more accurate than pistols or SMGs.
facts: Combat Focus drains the purple focus bar under health and stamina, and lasts only a few seconds.
There are four Focus levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
Cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count toward the five.
Each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter, per OutputLog.
Exophase lists this at 0.11% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: Which enemies count for Gunslinger?
dispute.a: Gang members at illegal operations count; police, soldiers and civilians seem not to.
dispute.b: The description just says enemies, so any five takedowns in one use should count.
dispute.call: Use gang enemies. The guides that tested it agree on that reading, and gang operations give you grouped targets anyway.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse it out to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away. The easiest jet sits at gates E3/E4; drive through a fence around the airfield and use the stairs by the boarding bridge. Planes parked out on the airfield do not count.
steps: Save first, then drive through a fence around the airfield toward the E3/E4 gates.
Take the stairs beside the boarding bridge and the door straight into the docked plane.
Go upstairs, enter the cockpit and drive the plane backward to the runway.
Take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport until the trophy pops.
Going through the terminal on foot also works, but the airfield route is faster.
facts: Only a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge counts; airfield-parked planes do not.
The pop is delayed until you are roughly 1 km clear of the airport.
Police arrive fast once you are inside, so the pre-save matters.
Exophase lists this at 0.29% of tracked players at launch.
The E3/E4 gates hold the easiest jet to reach.
You must fly about 1 km from the airport before the delayed pop.

dispute.q: Which planes count for Catch Me If You Can?
dispute.a: Only a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge, such as the E3/E4 jet.
dispute.b: The guides word it differently, and FullSweep flags the wording gap between them.
dispute.call: Use the E3/E4 docked jet. It is the tested method, and airfield-parked planes are reported not to count.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base; drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and fire on enemies until the trophy pops.
steps: Head to Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key, at the bottom of the Keys.
Enter through the gate or over the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance.
Find the tanks parked in the south of the base and climb into one.
Drive and fire on enemies until the trophy pops; leaving with one brings a 3-star wanted level.
facts: Several tanks sit unlocked in the south of the base.
PowerPyx also lists a guide to stealing the military fighter jet from the same base.
Exophase lists this at 0.24% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun, pick a jewelry store, use the Snap Gun on its locked back door, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave unseen. Kicking the door sets the alarm off. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies.
Pick a jewelry store, marked with a green icon once the area is unfogged.
Use the Snap Gun on the locked back door; kicking it triggers the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code and open the safe.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave without being seen.
If anyone spots you, reload and try again; the pop comes shortly after leaving.
facts: The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently; you never need to equip it.
Jewelry stores are part of the Smash 'N' Grab line on the 100% checklist.
Exophase lists this at 0.10% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any five of the eight large bank vaults and escape. Vaults open through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, where you tail a security van to a bank and slip into the vault while a guard has it open. Bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone. Each vault job instantly gives 4 stars, so a fast motorcycle and a vehicle swap are the escape plan.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is; the first vault is part of it.
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then enter the vault while the guard has it open.
Bring your partner and hand off a bag with Right when you cannot carry more.
After the mission, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans with purple icons.
Escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable.
Repeat until five vaults are robbed; the 100% checklist needs all eight.
facts: There are 8 large bank vaults in total; the trophy needs 5 and 100% needs all 8.
A single vault can pay up to $205,000, the best late-game money in the game.
Yasmani's tips need his earlier quests done first, including robbing 2 Payday Loans.
Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level.
Scrolling over a vault's map icon shows which ones you have already robbed.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.
Vaults pay up to $205,000 each, the best late-game money in the game.
Each vault robbery instantly triggers a 4-star wanted level.

dispute.q: 5 vaults or 8?
dispute.a: 5 bank vaults robbed and escaped for the trophy.
dispute.b: All 8 large bank vaults for the 100% checklist.
dispute.call: Rob all 8. The trophy pops at the fifth and the checklist line finishes at the eighth.

miss.w: Vaults only open through a Chapter 4 optional mission; the mission must be found and finished.
miss.p: Watch for That's Where The Money Is on the map in Chapter 4 and do it as soon as it appears. It is marked automatically from story progress.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. The easiest route is the same Chapter 4 optional mission that opens bank vaults: tailing the truck to a bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. Earlier, you can block a truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is; the vault robbery counts.
Or, earlier: find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City and block its path.
Plant a sticky bomb on the truck's back door and blow it open.
Escape the red heat radius, or use a Pay 'n' Spray, to pop the trophy.
facts: Sticky bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
Yasmani unlocks as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
The trophy only pops once you have left the heat zone.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the entire map is visible.
steps: Get a plane; one can be found early in Chapter 1.
Fly over every area still covered in black fog on the map.
Sweep the edges and the Keys last, since they are the easiest to leave fogged.
facts: Unfogging also marks banks, payday loans, jewelry stores and other robbery targets automatically.
The map starts under fog and the trophy counts once none is left.
Exophase lists this at 0.05% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Operations show as yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops on the way.
steps: Watch for yellow icons on the map as you travel; they mark illegal operations nearby.
Rob one operation from each of the nine gangs.
Track per-gang progress under Progress, Gangs, scrolling over each gang.
Keep going to all 39 operations for the 100% checklist.
facts: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total.
19 of the 39 get marked automatically from story progress.
Operations respawn after a while, so a missed key valuable can be collected later.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy, once you know the drink and the spot.
steps: Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar to pop the trophy.
facts: Several guides still list the exact trigger as unconfirmed, even though PowerPyx gives the full method.
The trophy is hidden on PSN until earned.
Exophase lists this at 0.21% of tracked players, the most common hidden side trophy.

dispute.q: Is the method for In The Beginning… confirmed?
dispute.a: Yes: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, one Apple Martini, drunk beside the bar.
dispute.b: Not yet: several guides list the exact trigger as still unconfirmed.
dispute.call: Follow PowerPyx: it is the only guide with a tested method, and the drink costs almost nothing to try.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Only this specific blue Banshee counts; the pop is slightly delayed, so drive on down the street after the smash.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs to get the Key Cloner.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City.
Hack into the blue Banshee with the Key Cloner.
Drive forward straight through the showroom window, then keep driving until it pops.
facts: Only the blue Banshee counts, not any other car in the showroom.
The stunt is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
Several guides still list the exact method as unconfirmed.
Exophase lists this at 0.02% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: Is the method for Capital Offense confirmed?
dispute.a: Yes: the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom, driven through the window after the Key Cloner.
dispute.b: Not yet: several guides list the exact method as still unconfirmed.
dispute.call: Follow PowerPyx: it names the car, the showroom and the tool, and the attempt is cheap if it fails.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables from Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, opened with code 0300 or sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You do not bowl a game.
steps: Reach the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; it is marked automatically.
Inside, take the luxury watch from the south-east office (golden icon).
Take the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun from the table in the north-east corner.
Loot the safe in the north-east hallway with code 0300 or sticky bombs.
Escape the police to pop the trophy; killing the enemies is not needed.
facts: The three valuables do not need to be stolen in one visit: the robbery icon respawns after a long time.
Kingpin Bowling is one of the 39 gang operations, so it feeds Pest Control and 100%.
No guide says you bowl a game; the bowling reading is a misread of the description.
Exophase lists this at 2.44% of tracked players, the most common hidden trophy overall.

dispute.q: Do you actually bowl for Let's Go Bowling?
dispute.a: No: you steal three key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation and escape.
dispute.b: Unclear: the description only hints at follow-through at the alley, and some guides list it as unconfirmed.
dispute.call: Steal the valuables. PowerPyx names all three and the safe code; nobody has produced a bowling method.

miss.w: The Kingpin Bowling robbery respawns only after a long time if you leave valuables behind.
miss.p: Grab all three valuables during the Chapter 2 optional mission. If you miss one, the icon does come back, so the trophy is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Buy a gym membership, bring your partner along, and work out together: while one character trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Strength is the heart icon under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, per character.
steps: Wait until after Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters.
Buy a gym membership at a fitness club; filter Map, Activities, for them.
Always bring your partner: hold Right and press Triangle to call them in.
Work out with one character while the other trains automatically.
Check Strength, the heart icon, for each character under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia.
facts: Training together doubles progress, since the partner finishes their session automatically.
There are many fitness clubs across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
Exophase lists this at 0.02% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: What does Personal Best actually need?
dispute.a: Maximum Strength on both Jason and Lucia at the same time.
dispute.b: Maximum body fat, the Overweight state, on both characters.
dispute.call: Train for Strength. Three guides agree on it, and the body-fat reading is a single second-hand report on one hub page.

miss.w: Needs both characters, which only opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
miss.p: Start gym sessions as soon as you can switch characters, and always train with your partner along for double progress.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, and watch for the little demon face on the right of the screen whenever something counts. Robberies and fights feed it passively, so it usually pops on its own during the other trophies.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications.
Play normally: finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence and clean escapes all count.
Check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list; it tracks toward 500.
If it is still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
facts: The profile runs Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable.
Irredeemable is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight more often, so avoid excessive violence.
Every robbery and enemy encounter counts toward the 500.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: Is the 500-action figure solid?
dispute.a: Yes: the trophy list itself tracks progress toward 500 profile actions.
dispute.b: Single-source: EGamers notes only one guide has published the number so far.
dispute.call: Trust the in-game counter. The trophy list shows the 500 target directly, so the figure is checkable in seconds.

miss.w: The Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes the whole cleanup harder.
miss.p: Vary your play: stealthy objectives and clean escapes count just as well as violence. Do not farm with mass killing until everything else is done.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: In the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. Return later as Lucia, alone and on foot, and rob the same store again: the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City. The earliest chance is after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Escape on foot, not in a vehicle, and the delayed pop comes once you are clear of the search area.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock Payday Loans robberies.
Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City, as Lucia alone, without Jason.
Aim at the teller, deal with security, break through and empty the three cash drawers.
Run away on foot until the trophy pops; driving away does not count.
facts: The trophy recreates the prologue robbery, which is why it must be Lucia, alone and on foot.
Several guides still list the method as unconfirmed.
The pop is delayed until you have escaped the police search area and run far enough.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: Is the method for Bad Luck, I Guess confirmed?
dispute.a: Yes: re-rob the Little Cuba Payday Loans as Lucia alone, then escape on foot.
dispute.b: Not yet: several guides list it as unconfirmed.
dispute.call: Follow PowerPyx: it names the store, the character, the unlock mission and the on-foot rule, and the attempt is quick.

miss.w: Needs Payday Loans robberies, which only unlock in Chapter 3, and the escape must be on foot.
miss.p: Wait for Credit Check, go as Lucia alone, and run. Driving away voids the attempt, so plan the escape route first.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM. Sometimes a blinking car waits at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods to the UFO's bright blue light, approach it, and when it drops the woman it abducted, talk to her, offer to help and walk her back to her car at the roadside.
steps: Go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if it is absent, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light in the sky.
Approach the UFO; it drops the woman it abducted.
Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside.
facts: The encounter is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn.
You must come alone; a partner breaks the setup.
Several guides still list the method as unconfirmed.
Exophase lists this at 1.41% of tracked players, unusually common for a hidden trophy.

dispute.q: Is the UFO method for The Truth Is Out There confirmed?
dispute.a: Yes: the Starlet Motel road after 2AM, the blinking car, the woods, the abducted woman.
dispute.b: Not yet: several guides list it as unconfirmed.
dispute.call: Follow PowerPyx and GTASix.how: both describe the same encounter, and the spawn is the only uncertain part.

miss.w: Random spawn, night-only after 2AM, and solo-only.
miss.p: Save near the Starlet Motel before 2AM, go alone, and retry the road until the blinking car appears.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach give you the foot traffic.
steps: Find any bike and ride to a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick pedestrians with Square as you ride past them.
Land 10 kicks inside 60 seconds to pop the trophy.
facts: The method is a melee kick from a moving bike, not a bowling ball.
Several guides still list the precise method as being confirmed.
Exophase lists this at 0.10% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: What does Ten Pin actually need?
dispute.a: Ten pedestrians kicked from a bike with Square within 60 seconds.
dispute.b: Unconfirmed: several guides only repeat the melee drive-by hint.
dispute.call: Try the bike kicks. It is the only concrete method published, and a crowded street makes it a one-minute test.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and payday loans and bring the marked bills to a fence. Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total builds across robberies, and one large bank vault can pay up to $205,000 in a single job.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and payday loans to collect Marked Bills.
Bring the bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Keep going until $250,000 is laundered in total; it need not be in one delivery.
Lean on bank vaults late on: one vault can pay up to $205,000.
facts: The 100% checklist also needs $250,000 of marked bills fenced, so the two finish together.
Bank vaults only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

miss.w: Some fences disappear permanently as the story moves on.
miss.p: Use Yasmani once he is unlocked and launder regularly instead of hoarding bills. The fences that vanish have no quests, but a lost fence is still a lost payout route.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shop types. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest route, since they are the most expensive purchases.
steps: Spend across any shops: the total is cumulative across every shop type.
Buy guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations and mods at the 14 mod shops for the biggest tickets.
Add tattoos, clothing and electronics until the $100,000 total is reached.
facts: Leonida has 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and 11 tattoo studios, among other shop types.
Bank vault money funds this comfortably in the late game.
Exophase lists this at 0.13% of tracked players at launch.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, for about $160,000 in total. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses. The four story garages do not count.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Open the app on your phone and buy each of the eight purchasable garages.
Fund it with robberies, which pay far more from Chapter 3 onward.
facts: The eight garages cost about $160,000 in total.
There are four more garages from the story, which do not count toward the trophy.
Garage space is also what On the Spot needs to register vehicles.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.

dispute.q: How many garages are there?
dispute.a: Eight purchasable garages, plus four from the story, for 12 locations in total.
dispute.b: The trophy text says 8, but the map database lists 12 garage locations.
dispute.call: Both numbers describe the same garages: buy the 8 the app sells and ignore the 4 story ones.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage. Each vehicle needs a free garage space, so buy garages first, and register cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep costs down.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app and Moses himself.
Buy garages first, since each registered vehicle needs a free parking space.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.
Repeat with cheap low-end cars and bikes until 10 are registered.
From Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray.
facts: Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers at first.
Registering a vehicle costs money, so cheap cars keep the bill down.
Each garage adds one or more parking spots for registered vehicles.
Exophase lists this at 0.01% of tracked players at launch.
